claim: NAO PFI and PF2 (HC 718): indicative cost of capital for PFI 2% to 3.75% above government gilts (2010 National Infrastructure Plan); IPA data on PFI/PF2 deals since 2013: investors forecast returns 2% to 4% above government borrowing; some 2013 deals more than 5% above
title: PFI and PF2, Report by the Comptroller and Auditor General, HC 718 Session 2017-2019
quote: "The 2010 National Infrastructure Plan estimated an indicative cost of capital for PFI as 2% to 3.75% above the cost of government gilts."
